title: Present and Future Requirements of Soft X-Ray Projection Lithography

passages.note: Printed pp. 576–577, Introduction. An NTT participant paper reports a 1986 laboratory demonstration of reduced patterns with soft X-rays and multilayer mirrors and a later move to a reflective mask. It identifies laboratory results and target developments. The dates in this paper do not resolve experiment versus first presentation.

lineage: University-hosted scan of the invited July 1992 conference paper, in proceedings copyright 1993. The introduction and figure context were inspected.
